name: Legion of Doom
description: The Legion of Doom (LOD) was an American hacker group founded by 'Lex Luthor' in 1984 after a split from the Knights of Shadow. One of the most influential hacking groups in the history of technology, LOD was active through the early 2000s and became famous for phone phreaking, system intrusions, and publishing technical hacking guides. The group had a prolonged rivalry with the New York-based Masters of Deception.
